name: postcue
description: Plan social posts from your assistant. Postcue reminds you on your phone at the right time with the frames and caption ready, and you post them yourself.

interface.shortDescription: Cue your social posts on time
interface.longDescription:
Postcue is a posting reminder for people who run several social accounts. Your assistant sets up your brands and accounts, schedules posts with their frames and caption, and checks which account has gone quiet. At the due time the Postcue app sends a cue: the frames go to Photos in order, the caption to the clipboard, and the network's app opens. You add the music and the last touches and post it yourself.

Postcue never posts on your behalf and never asks for your social network passwords. It only reads and writes your own Postcue workspaces, accounts and posts.

You can ask it to set up workspaces for your brands with their Instagram, TikTok, X, Threads, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest or Reddit accounts, to schedule a post with images or a video for a given time, to move, edit or cancel a planned post, or to tell you which accounts haven't posted lately and suggest what to post next.

You need the Postcue phone app to get the cues. Sign in with the same email in the app and here.
capabilities: Set up brands and their social accounts
Schedule posts with frames and a caption
Move, edit, skip or cancel planned posts
Show which accounts have gone quiet
defaultPrompt: What's in my Postcue queue this week?
Which of my accounts have gone quiet? Suggest a post for the quietest one.
Move my next Instagram post to Friday at 18:00.

positive.expected_behavior: Show the Sweet Crumbs and Trailhead workspaces with their four social accounts.
List the croissant carousel, the lamination reel, the trail kit reel and a draft story, with their times and accounts.

positive.prompt: Which account has been quiet longest?
positive.expected_behavior: Name @trailheadgear on YouTube, quiet for about five weeks.

positive.description: Add an account with a weekly goal
positive.prompt: Add a Pinterest account @sweetcrumbs to Sweet Crumbs and give it a goal of 1 post a week.
positive.expected_behavior: Add the Pinterest account with a goal of one post a week. It then appears under Sweet Crumbs in list_workspaces.

positive.description: Schedule a post with an image
positive.prompt: Schedule a Trailhead Instagram post called 'Rain gear check' for next Monday at 17:00 with this image: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1501555088652-021faa106b9b?w=1080
positive.expected_behavior: Create a cued post for next Monday at 17:00 on Trailhead's Instagram account with one frame. It then appears in list_posts.

negative.prompt: Post the croissant carousel to Instagram now.

review.commerce_description: Postcue sells no products in ChatGPT and processes no payments.
